acceptance_boundary: Controlled mode is a local scheduling and normalization regression. Real mode is a finite measured run; neither proves a supplier SLA or sustained upstream capacity.
known_metric_limitations: The original runtime completed counter means normal execution return, including business PARTIAL and FAILED; use run_states for actual business outcomes.
Actual measurements used Python 3.13.5 outside the declared supported versions; supported-runtime real load was not verified.
Only one repetition per task-count size was executed. Further repetitions were blocked by exhausted upstream quota.
evidence_retention_limitation: Original benchmark retained node statuses, missing-field flags, timings, and ephemeral fact references only. Raw Provider responses and normalized values were held in an in-memory benchmark database that was closed. Full original values cannot be recovered from this evidence; no upstream re-execution was performed.
